description: This Java source file defines the class TagsExtractorImpl, which implements the TagsExtractor interface. It manages extraction and suggestion of tags for quick text features in the AnySoftKeyboard project, including dictionary management, suggestions based on tags, and handling of quick key history.

classes.name: TagsExtractorImpl
classes.description: Implements tag extraction and suggestion logic for quick text features, managing dictionaries, suggestions, and history.

classes.name: MyCodesProvider
